subject: an open parachute
sourceSummary: Author a concrete, tested rollback plan for a release so that when a deploy goes wrong the team can revert FAST and safely without improvising under pressure — covering the trigger conditions that mean 'roll back', the exact reversal steps (redeploy previous artifact, down-migrations, flag flips, cache/CDN invalidation), data-safety and forward/backward-compatibility considerations, the recovery-time estimate, and a post-rollback verification.
